label: Link under the gallery
context: Link below the apps carousel on the homepage, to the full Apps page.

label: Previous button
context: Arrow button left of the dots under the carousel; also its tooltip. Turns the ring back one app.

label: Next button
context: Arrow button right of the dots; also its tooltip.

label: Dots label
context: Not shown. What screen readers call the row of dots under the carousel.

label: Region role
context: Not shown. Screen readers announce the gallery as a carousel.
notes: lower case; read after the heading

label: Slide role
context: Not shown. Screen readers announce each app card as a slide.

label: Slide position
context: Not shown. Screen readers read e.g. '3 of 8' for each card.

label: Change announcement
context: Not shown. Read out when someone moves to another app, e.g. 'Eleven, 3 of 8'.

label: Screenshot description
context: Not shown. Describes each screenshot to screen readers, e.g. 'Eleven’s website'.

label: Step back
context: Small icon button in the 'Your agent' demo box's top bar; tooltip and screen-reader name. Jumps back one turn of the conversation.

label: Step forward
context: Icon button beside it; jumps forward one turn.

label: Slower
context: The '−' button of the speed control; tooltip and screen-reader name.

label: Faster
context: The '+' button of the speed control.

label: Speed readout
context: Shown between − and +, e.g. '1.5×'.

label: Speed control name
context: Not shown. What screen readers call the speed control.

label: Thinking dots
context: Not shown. Screen-reader label for the three animated dots before each agent reply.

label: Switch name
context: Not shown. Screen-reader name for the three small icons in the footer.

label: Auto
context: Tooltip and screen-reader name of the half-circle icon: follow the device's light or dark setting.

label: Light
context: Tooltip and name of the sun icon.

label: Dark
context: Tooltip and name of the moon icon.
